findings.message: sensitive GitHub token permissions: issues:write, pull-requests:write
findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants write access to a sensitive GITHUB_TOKEN scope.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: decodes obfuscated payload and executes it in the same file
findings.remediation: Remove all decode-and-execute patterns; they are strongly correlated with malicious behavior.
findings.impact: Decoded payload executed in same file — classic obfuscation-to-RCE pattern.
findings.attack_vector: Buffer.from(base64).toString() → eval() chain; the base64 payload is invisible to static review.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: uses WebAssembly compilation or instantiation (3 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Review all WASM sources; untrusted WASM can execute arbitrary machine code.
findings.impact: WebAssembly modules execute arbitrary machine code at native speed, invisible to JS-level sandboxing.
findings.attack_vector: Untrusted .wasm binary loaded via WebAssembly.instantiate() — no source verification.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: disables TLS verification or references plaintext HTTP transport (5 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS and keep TLS certificate verification enabled.
findings.impact: Disabling TLS verification or using plaintext HTTP allows MITM interception of all traffic.
findings.attack_vector: rejectUnauthorized: false or http:// URL — attacker can intercept/modify all requests.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
